rci1_using_msad.detail: Single regional study; participants recruited from Oslo area clinics and healthy individuals from the same catchment area
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: Patients were recruited from inpatient and outpatient clinics in the Oslo area of Norway, and healthy individuals from the same catchment area were drawn from the national population registry.
